resources.string: Enables secure, isolated dual-app containers without modifying APK signatures.
Optimized for WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger. Background sync active, dual media storage, native notifications.
Isolates data strictly. Zero cross-profile communication, disabled contacts sync, wiped cache on exit.
Safe from anti-cheat bans. Untouched APK signatures, no memory hooking artifacts, uncapped frame rate.
Unrestricted debug environment, isolated storage inspection, logcat streaming support.
